patches.reason: Connect the pinned GrapheneOS Android 17 Dialer Telecom lifecycle to model priority and the fail-closed AIOS Call Intelligence policy and capture service.
patches.removal_condition: Remove only if the device base exposes an equivalent stable call-assistant lifecycle API requiring no Dialer source hook.
patches.rebase_notes: Verify or re-export from the signed 2026080500 Dialer commit, preserve the four-file footprint, and pass host, emulator Telecom, and physical call gates.

patches.reason: Allow the platform-signed AIOS Messaging app to link the maintained MMS codec and provider persister on the pinned full-device Android 17 base.
patches.removal_condition: Remove when the device base exports framework-mms-shared-srcs to product modules or supplies an equivalent supported MMS library.
patches.rebase_notes: Verify or re-export from the signed 2026080500 frameworks/base commit and retain only the vendor subtree visibility change.

patches.reason: Replace the Pixel lane launcher fork with the exact Android 17 AOSP Launcher3 base and apply the shared AIOS Home topic with selected grid, search UX, and stability fixes.
patches.removal_condition: Remove individual carried fixes when upstream Launcher3 provides equivalent behavior; remove the topic only if AIOS stops shipping its launcher.
patches.rebase_notes: Advance the dedicated Launcher3 manifest override to the next official Android tag, audit the carried fixes, regenerate this shared patch, and pass both integration and Pixel launcher test matrices before release.
